prompt:
Review one candidate time core [22291,22310) in entity machine-1-2.
Route reason: dino_proposal. dino_proposal uses the original DINO spike/height and seasonal evidence. dino_partial_tail_review covers a final partial window without DINO scores (seasonal scores may exist). unscored_tail_review covers samples beyond the saved Stage1 output. Both tail routes are forced reviews, NOT DINO anomaly claims. Percentile scores are NOT anomaly probabilities. The 224-tick display is [22188,22412); its axes show tile-relative ticks. The candidate is [103,122) on these axes, end excluded. No candidate boundary is drawn; orange marks each local zoom, not the candidate. Context outside the candidate is context only. Other proposals may appear anywhere in the display; a change outside the candidate is not a reason to accept this candidate. If location or association is unclear, respond uncertain.
The heatmap shows all 38 channels. Detailed channels on this page: [1, 3, 14, 0, 2, 32, 8]. Round 0, page 1/1. Judge event validity IN THE CORE separately from which displayed channels react. A channel can visibly spike in a normal repeating state. Selecting a channel alone does not establish an anomalous event. Do not infer root causes or causal direction.
Black is observed, dashed blue the retrieved normal-train median. The light-blue band is a descriptive range only. No reference-support quality claim is provided. Neither is a calibrated normality boundary. A flat median may erase ordinary spikes. Inspect full traces, local changes and pre/post behavior. Display-local-change focus is only a viewer aid; Stage1 peak focus preserves the source detector's location.
Reference quality: []. Supported context does not establish focus normality. A difference from normal reference, low support p or rare coupling alone cannot establish anomaly. Use uncertain when the evidence does not resolve normal state change versus anomaly. Confidence is descriptive and will not be used as a probability.
If another heatmap channel needs a detailed view, request its zero-based ID in additional_channels_to_review. At most one additional review round is available. Do not classify unseen channels as normal; normal_repeat applies only to the displayed candidate hypothesis, not proof that every channel is normal.
Return ONLY JSON, no prose:
{"event_validity":"anomalous"|"normal_repeat"|"uncertain","anomalous_channels":[subset of [1, 3, 14, 0, 2, 32, 8]],"channel_ranking":[ordered subset of [1, 3, 14, 0, 2, 32, 8]],"confidence":"low"|"medium"|"high","additional_channels_to_review":[IDs needing detailed review]}

REFERENCE RETRIEVAL NOTE: The normal-train curves in this image were selected using the entire already-observed 60-tick candidate focus, rather than pre-focus context alone. A close match can occur by chance or because training data contain unusual events; it does not prove normality. No pre-focus or full-focus reference-quality claim is provided for this image. Judge event validity conservatively; do not treat focus matching as a calibrated anomaly score.
